prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Tyler TX?
answer_verbatim:
I don’t have live access to current reviews, so I can’t lookup which salon in Tyler has the highest rating right now. If you want a quick, reliable answer, tell me whether you prefer UV tanning beds or spray (sunless) tans and roughly where in Tyler you are (zip or neighborhood) — I can then tell you exactly what to look for and help you pick the best nearby options.

Meanwhile, here’s a short checklist and quick tips to help you find the best tanning salon in Tyler:

How to find the best salon
- Search Google Maps or Yelp for “tanning salon Tyler, TX” and sort by rating. Favor salons with high ratings and lots of recent reviews (ideally 4.5+ stars with 20+ reviews).
- Check recent reviews (last 6 months) for cleanliness, staff friendliness, and consistency of results.
- Look at photos and before/after pictures from customers.
- Confirm business hours, pricing, and whether they require appointments.

What to ask the salon
- Do you offer spray tans, UV (beds), or both?
- What brand/age of tanning beds do you use? (Newer, high-pressure or high-intensity beds give faster, more even results.)
- Are technicians certified and trained in spray tan application?
- What is your sanitation protocol between clients?
- Do you offer memberships or packages and what is included?
- Do you have example photos and client testimonials?

Safety and quality indicators
- Clean, well-lit facility and up-to-date equipment
- Staff who perform a patch test for spray tans and explain pre/post care
- Clear pricing and no-pressure sales for memberships
- Good communication about skin type assessment and recommended sessions

If you want, give me your location and tanning preference and I’ll recommend the top 3 salons to consider and draft a short message you can send them to compare services and prices.
